_comment: IDE-only tsconfig: resolves the customer authoring aliases for type checking in editors. The build (Vite + SvelteKit) resolves these aliases from each consumer config, so this file must not be used for compilation (noEmit is set). verbatimModuleSyntax must stay: svelte-preprocess picks the nearest tsconfig from the FILE's directory, and without the flag TypeScript strips template-only value imports inside <script>, which crashes SvelteKit builds with 'X is not defined'.
